frontier.note: the declared cap passes; the frontier is above the search range

admissible_region.note: the constructive output of the screen: a region the generator may propose inside, rather than an oracle that only ever says no

acceleration_range.note: even the weakest anchor sits more than four orders of magnitude above a0, which is why this regime refutes and does not discover

approximations.near_circular_apsidal_formula: the precession channel uses the near-circular apsidal angle pi/sqrt(3+s), an O(1) approximation at planetary eccentricities; MODEL_SLACK absorbs it
approximations.single_body_keplerian_anchors: each planet is treated as a test body on a Keplerian orbit about the Sun; planetary perturbations are not modelled and are not needed at these margins

provenance.one_sided_consequence: the screen may fail to reject a law that published data would reject; it cannot reject a law that published data would admit

channels.fractional_deviation: |nu(y_i)/nu(y_ref) - 1| against the most Newtonian anchor.  Not |nu - 1|: a constant nu rescales GM_Sun and is not observable
channels.perihelion_precession_mas_per_century: 1296000000 * (1/sqrt(1 - 2L) - 1) * (100/T_years) with L = d ln nu / d ln y, the near-circular apsidal advance; pi cancels and nothing transcendental is evaluated

constants.provenance: GM_Sun is the IAU 2015 Resolution B3 nominal solar mass parameter and the astronomical unit is the IAU 2012 definition; both are defined constants.  a0 is the conventional MOND acceleration scale

evidential_framing.fail_evidential_weight: decisive for the law as declared
evidential_framing.why: solar accelerations sit 4 to 8 orders of magnitude above a0, and every MOND-class response law is constructed to reduce to Newton there; passing this screen confirms the construction, not the law

scope_restriction: surviving_family_local_factor screens sqrt(1 + a0/g_N) on its own.  The twelve families of nonlocal-localization-v1 also carry a curvature-screening factor whose solar behaviour is NOT evaluated here, so this is a refutation of the local factor taken alone and not of those families as published

screened_candidates.gm_degeneracy_note: nu varies across the anchor set, so the fractional channel has power here

law.name: two_term_simple_expansion
law.note: nu = 1 + y^-1 - y^-2: the next order of the simple interpolating function's expansion, screened to show that a higher-order term does not rescue a law whose leading recovery is linear

screened_candidates.gm_degeneracy_note: nu varies across the anchor set, so the fractional channel has power here

law.name: generous_quadratic_recovery
law.note: nu = 1 + 100 y^-2: a hundred times the standard function's coefficient, screened to show how much room the quadratic-recovery region actually has
